sections.title: Daily life
sections.sub: From the Sunnah, as gathered by Imam al-Nawawi in al-Adhkar

items.ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور
items.en: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on waking

items.ar: باسمك اللهم أحيا وأموت
items.en: In Your name, O Allah, I live and I die.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on going to bed

items.ar: باسمك ربي وضعت جنبي، وبك أرفعه، إن أمسكت نفسي فارحمها، وإن أرسلتها فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين
items.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side, and by You I raise it. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (6320) and Muslim (2714); al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on going to bed
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ also blew into his hands, recited al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and al-Nas and wiped his body (al-Bukhari and Muslim).

items.ar: بسم الله، اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الخبث والخبائث
items.en: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from male and female devils.
items.src: al-Bukhari (142) and Muslim (375), with 'bismillah' in Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

items.ar: غفرانك، الحمد لله الذي أذهب عني الأذى وعافاني
items.en: I ask Your forgiveness. Praise be to Allah who took away the harm from me and gave me well-being.
items.src: Abu Dawud (30) and al-Tirmidhi (7), the rest in al-Nasa'i and Ibn Majah; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

items.ar: أشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، وأشهد أن محمدا عبده ورسوله، اللهم اجعلني من التوابين، واجعلني من المتطهرين
items.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, with no partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me of those who repent and of those who purify themselves.
items.src: Sahih Muslim, from 'Umar رضي الله عنه, with the last line added in al-Tirmidhi; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say after wudu

items.ar: الحمد لله الذي كساني هذا ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة
items.en: Praise be to Allah who clothed me in this and provided it for me, with no power or strength from me.
items.src: Abu Dawud and Ibn al-Sunni (272), from Mu'adh ibn Anas رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says it has his past sins forgiven.

items.ar: بسم الله، توكلت على الله، لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
items.en: In the name of Allah. I put my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except by Allah.
items.src: Abu Dawud (5095) and al-Tirmidhi (3426), from Anas رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.note: It is said to him: you are guided, protected and sufficed, and Shaytan moves away from him.

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك خير المولج، وخير المخرج، باسم الله ولجنا، وباسم الله خرجنا، وعلى الله ربنا توكلنا
items.en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of entering and the good of leaving. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
items.src: Abu Dawud, from Abu Malik al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.note: Then greet your family with salam.

items.ar: بسم الله
items.en: In the name of Allah.
items.src: al-Bukhari and Muslim; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, saying bismillah over food
items.note: If you forget at the start, say: بسم الله أوله وآخره — 'In the name of Allah at its beginning and its end' (Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi).

items.ar: الحمد لله الذي أطعمني هذا ورزقنيه من غير حول مني ولا قوة
items.en: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me, with no power or strength from me.
items.src: Abu Dawud, al-Tirmidhi (3458) and Ibn Majah (3285); al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say after eating
items.note: Whoever says it has his past sins forgiven. Al-Tirmidhi: hasan.

items.ar: اللهم افتح لي أبواب رحمتك
items.en: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
items.note: Send salam on the Prophet ﷺ first (Abu Dawud) and enter with the right foot.

items.ar: اللهم إني أسألك من فضلك
items.en: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.

items.ar: قل هو الله أحد، والمعوذتين، ثلاث مرات
items.en: Recite al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and al-Nas three times, morning and evening.
items.src: Abu Dawud and al-Tirmidhi; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, morning and evening
items.note: 'They will suffice you against everything.' Al-Tirmidhi: hasan sahih.

items.ar: اللهم أنت ربي، لا إله إلا أنت، خلقتني وأنا عبدك، وأنا على عهدك ووعدك ما استطعت، أبوء لك بنعمتك علي، وأبوء لك بذنبي، فاغفر لي، فإنه لا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت، أعوذ بك من شر ما صنعت
items.en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I acknowledge Your blessings on me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (6323), from Shaddad ibn Aws رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, morning and evening
items.note: Whoever says it in the evening and dies that night is of the people of Paradise, and likewise in the morning.

items.ar: سبحان الذي سخر لنا هذا وما كنا له مقرنين وإنا إلى ربنا لمنقلبون، اللهم إنا نسألك في سفرنا هذا البر والتقوى، ومن العمل ما ترضى، اللهم هون علينا سفرنا هذا، واطو عنا بعده، اللهم أنت الصاحب في السفر، والخليفة في الأهل، اللهم إني أعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر، وكآبة المنظر، وسوء المنقلب في المال والأهل
items.en: Glory be to the One who subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves; to our Lord we will return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness and piety, and deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy and shorten its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the One who looks after the family. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, a sad sight, and a bad return to wealth and family.
items.src: Sahih Muslim, from Ibn 'Umar رضي الله عنهما; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say when mounting
items.note: Say 'Allahu akbar' three times first. On returning, add: آيبون تائبون عابدون لربنا حامدون.

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله العظيم الحليم، لا إله إلا الله رب العرش العظيم، لا إله إلا الله رب السموات ورب الأرض رب العرش الكريم
items.en: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the mighty Throne. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the noble Throne.
items.src: al-Bukhari (6345) and Muslim (2730), from Ibn 'Abbas رضي الله عنهما; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, times of hardship

items.ar: اللهم أنا عبدك، وابن عبدك، وابن أمتك، في قبضتك، ناصيتي بيدك، ماض في حكمك، عدل في قضاؤك، أسألك بكل اسم هو لك سميت به نفسك، أو أنزلته في كتابك، أو علمته أحدا من خلقك، أو استأثرت به في علم الغيب عندك، أن تجعل القرآن العظيم نور صدري، وربيع قلبي، وجلاء حزني، وذهاب همي
items.en: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, in Your grasp. My forelock is in Your hand; Your judgement over me is done and Your decree for me is just. I ask You by every name that is Yours, by which You named Yourself, or sent down in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept with You in the knowledge of the unseen, to make the Mighty Qur'an the light of my chest, the spring of my heart, the removal of my sorrow and the end of my worry.
items.src: Ibn al-Sunni (341), from Abu Musa al-Ash'ari رضي الله عنه; also in Musnad Ahmad from Ibn Mas'ud رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, times of hardship
items.note: The Prophet ﷺ said: whoever says them, seeking what is in them, Allah removes his grief and lengthens his joy. 'Say them and teach them.'

items.ar: اللهم رب الناس أذهب البأس، اشف أنت الشافي، لا شفاء إلا شفاؤك، شفاء لا يغادر سقما
items.en: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness.
items.src: al-Bukhari (5743) and Muslim (2191), from 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar
items.note: He ﷺ would wipe with his right hand while saying it.

items.ar: بسم الله (ثلاثا) — أعوذ بعزة الله وقدرته من شر ما أجد وأحاذر (سبع مرات)
items.en: Place your hand where it hurts and say 'Bismillah' three times, then seven times: I seek refuge in the might and power of Allah from the evil of what I feel and fear.
items.src: Sahih Muslim (2202), from 'Uthman ibn Abi al-'As رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

items.ar: اللهم صيبا نافعا
items.en: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
items.src: Sahih al-Bukhari (1032), from 'A'ishah رضي الله عنها; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

items.ar: اللهم أهله علينا باليمن والإيمان، والسلامة والإسلام، ربي وربك الله
items.en: O Allah, bring it over us with blessing and faith, safety and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
items.src: al-Tirmidhi (3451), from Talhah رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

items.ar: الحمد لله، اللهم كما حسنت خلقي فحسن خلقي
items.en: Praise be to Allah. O Allah, as You have made my form beautiful, make my character beautiful.
items.src: Ibn al-Sunni, from 'Ali رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar

items.ar: لا إله إلا الله وحده لا شريك له، له الملك، وله الحمد، يحيي ويميت، وهو حي لا يموت، بيده الخير، وهو على كل شيء قدير
items.en: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is Living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He has power over all things.
items.src: al-Tirmidhi (3428), from 'Umar رضي الله عنه; al-Nawawi, al-Adhkar, what to say on entering the market

items.ar: يرحمك الله
items.en: May Allah have mercy on you.
items.note: The one who sneezes says 'al-hamdu lillah'; whoever hears him replies 'yarhamuk Allah'.

sections.title: The 40 Rabbana
sections.sub: Du'as from the Qur'an that begin 'Our Lord'
sections.credit: Qur'an text: Tanzil Project (tanzil.net), CC BY 3.0, copied verbatim.

items.t: 1. Ibrahim and Isma'il عليهما السلام, building the Ka'bah
items.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, accept this from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
items.who: Ibrahim and Isma'il عليهما السلام, building the Ka'bah

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, make us submit to You, and of our descendants a nation that submits to You. Show us our rites, and turn to us in mercy; You are the Relenting, the Merciful.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, pour patience upon us, make our feet firm and help us against the disbelieving people.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
items.en: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or make a mistake.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
items.en: Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like that You placed on those before us.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
items.en: Our Lord, do not let our hearts swerve after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. You are the Giver.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.en: Our Lord, You will gather mankind on a Day about which there is no doubt. Allah does not break His promise.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we believe in what You sent down and we follow the Messenger, so write us among those who bear witness.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses in our affairs, make our feet firm and help us against the disbelieving people.

items.t: 13. People of understanding, reflecting on creation
items.ar: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.en: Our Lord, You did not create this in vain. Glory be to You; protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
items.who: People of understanding, reflecting on creation

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
items.en: Our Lord, whoever You admit to the Fire You have disgraced, and the wrongdoers will have no helpers.

items.ar: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا
items.en: Our Lord, we heard a caller calling to faith: 'Believe in your Lord', and we believed.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us our sins, wipe away our misdeeds, and take us with the righteous.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
items.en: Our Lord, give us what You promised us through Your Messengers, and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. You do not break Your promise.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْ هَٰذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ الظَّالِمِ أَهْلُهَا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّا وَاجْعَل لَّنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ نَصِيرًا
items.en: Our Lord, bring us out of this town whose people are oppressors, and appoint for us from Yourself a protector and a helper.

items.t: 19. Those who wept on hearing the truth
items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we believe, so write us among those who bear witness.
items.who: Those who wept on hearing the truth

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِّنكَ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, send down to us a table spread from heaven, to be a festival for the first and last of us and a sign from You. Provide for us; You are the best of providers.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth; You are the best of judges.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, pour patience upon us and let us die as Muslims.

items.t: 25. The people of Musa عليه السلام
items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
items.who: The people of Musa عليه السلام

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
items.en: Our Lord, You know what we hide and what we show; nothing on earth or in heaven is hidden from Allah.

items.ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
items.en: My Lord, make me one who establishes the prayer, and of my descendants too. Our Lord, accept my supplication.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
items.en: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning takes place.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
items.en: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself and set right our affair for us.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
items.en: Our Lord, we fear that he will hasten against us or transgress.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
items.en: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us; You are the best of those who show mercy.

items.t: 32. The servants of the Most Merciful
items.ar: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
items.en: Our Lord, turn away from us the punishment of Hell; its punishment is lasting. It is an evil place to settle and to stay.
items.who: The servants of the Most Merciful

items.t: 33. The servants of the Most Merciful
items.ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
items.en: Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and children the coolness of our eyes, and make us leaders of the God-fearing.
items.who: The servants of the Most Merciful

items.t: 34. The angels who carry the Throne
items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
items.en: Our Lord, You embrace all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of Hell.
items.who: The angels who carry the Throne

items.t: 35. The angels who carry the Throne
items.ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, admit them to the Gardens of Eden which You promised them, with the righteous among their fathers, spouses and descendants; You are the Mighty, the Wise. Protect them from evil deeds; whoever You protect from evil that Day, You have had mercy on him, and that is the great triumph.
items.who: The angels who carry the Throne

items.ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا
items.en: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who came before us in faith, and do not put in our hearts any rancour towards those who believe.

items.ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
items.en: Our Lord, You are Most Kind, Most Merciful.

items.t: 38. Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him
items.ar: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
items.en: Our Lord, upon You we rely, to You we turn, and to You is the return.
items.who: Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him

items.t: 39. Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him
items.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
items.en: Our Lord, do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord. You are the Mighty, the Wise.
items.who: Ibrahim عليه السلام and those with him

items.t: 40. The believers on the Day of Resurrection
items.ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
items.en: Our Lord, perfect our light for us and forgive us; You have power over all things.
items.who: The believers on the Day of Resurrection

sections.title: From Imam al-Ghazali
sections.sub: The du'as of the day in Bidayat al-Hidayah
sections.credit: From our copy of Bidayat al-Hidayah. A few scanning slips in that copy were corrected to the well-known wording of these du'as.

items.ar: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور، أصبحنا وأصبح الملك لله، والعظمة والسلطان لله، والعزة والقدرة لله رب العالمين، أصبحنا على فطرة الإسلام، وعلى كلمة الإخلاص، وعلى دين نبينا محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وعلى ملة أبينا إبراهيم حنيفا مسلما وما كان من المشركين، اللهم بك أصبحنا، وبك أمسينا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك النشور، اللهم إنا نسألك أن تبعثنا في هذا اليوم إلى كل خير، ونعوذ بك أن نجترح فيه سوءا أو نجره إلى مسلم، أو يجره أحد إلينا، نسألك خير هذا اليوم وخير ما فيه، ونعوذ بك من شر هذا اليوم وشر ما فيه
items.en: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the return. We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, and greatness and authority, might and power belong to Allah, Lord of the worlds. We have entered the morning upon the natural way of Islam, the word of sincerity, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Ibrahim, upright and submitting, who was not of the idolaters. O Allah, by You we enter the morning and the evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the return. O Allah, we ask You to send us forth today to every good, and we seek refuge in You from committing evil today, or bringing it on a Muslim, or anyone bringing it on us. We ask You for the good of this day and what is in it, and seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil of what is in it.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of waking
items.note: Al-Ghazali: try to wake before dawn, and let the first thing on your heart and tongue be the remembrance of Allah.

items.ar: اللهم طهر قلبي من النفاق، وحصن فرجي من الفواحش
items.en: O Allah, purify my heart of hypocrisy and guard my chastity from indecency.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of the toilet

items.ar: عند المضمضة: اللهم أعني على تلاوة كتابك وكثرة الذكر لك، وثبتني بالقول الثابت في الحياة الدنيا وفي الآخرة ۞ عند الاستنشاق: اللهم أرحني رائحة الجنة وأنت عني راض ۞ عند الاستنثار: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من روائح النار وسوء الدار ۞ عند غسل الوجه: اللهم بيض وجهي بنورك يوم تبيض وجوه أوليائك، ولا تسود وجهي بظلماتك يوم تسود وجوه أعدائك ۞ عند غسل اليد اليمنى: اللهم أعطني كتابي بيميني، وحاسبني حسابا يسيرا ۞ عند غسل اليسرى: اللهم إني أعوذ بك أن تعطيني كتابي بشمالي أو من وراء ظهري ۞ عند مسح الرأس: اللهم غشني برحمتك، وأنزل علي من بركاتك، وأظلني تحت ظل عرشك يوم لا ظل إلا ظلك، اللهم حرم شعري وبشري على النار ۞ عند مسح الأذنين: اللهم اجعلني من الذين يستمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه، اللهم أسمعني منادي الجنة في الجنة مع الأبرار ۞ عند مسح الرقبة: اللهم فك رقبتي من النار، وأعوذ بك من السلاسل والأغلال ۞ عند غسل الرجل اليمنى: اللهم ثبت قدمي على الصراط المستقيم مع أقدام عبادك الصالحين ۞ عند غسل اليسرى: اللهم إني أعوذ بك أن تزل قدمي على الصراط في النار يوم تزل أقدام المنافقين والمشركين
items.en: Rinsing the mouth: O Allah, help me to recite Your Book and remember You much, and make me firm with the firm word in this life and the next. Drawing water into the nose: let me smell the scent of Paradise while You are pleased with me. Blowing it out: I seek refuge in You from the smells of the Fire and an evil abode. The face: brighten my face with Your light on the Day the faces of Your friends are brightened, and do not darken it with Your darkness on the Day the faces of Your enemies are darkened. Right arm: give me my book in my right hand and make my reckoning easy. Left arm: I seek refuge in You from being given my book in my left hand or from behind my back. Head: cover me with Your mercy, send down Your blessings on me, shade me under Your Throne on the Day there is no shade but Yours, and forbid my hair and skin to the Fire. Ears: make me of those who listen to the word and follow the best of it, and let me hear the caller of Paradise in Paradise with the righteous. Neck: free my neck from the Fire; I seek refuge in You from the chains and shackles. Right foot: make my foot firm on the straight Bridge with the feet of Your righteous servants. Left foot: I seek refuge in You from my foot slipping off the Bridge into the Fire on the Day the feet of the hypocrites and idolaters slip.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of wudu
items.note: Al-Ghazali recommends these. Imam al-Nawawi notes in al-Adhkar that these limb-by-limb du'as are not reported from the Prophet ﷺ; they are good words of du'a, said without believing them to be a sunnah.

items.t: Answering the adhan, then after it
items.ar: يقول مثل ما يقول المؤذن، وفي الحيعلتين: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم — ثم: اللهم إني أسألك عند حضور صلاتك، وأصوات دعاتك، وإدبار ليلك، وإقبال نهارك، أن تؤتي محمدا الوسيلة والفضيلة والدرجة الرفيعة، وابعثه المقام المحمود الذي وعدته، إنك لا تخلف الميعاد
items.en: Repeat what the mu'adhdhin says, and at 'hayya 'ala al-salah / al-falah' say: there is no power and no strength except by Allah, the High, the Mighty. Then: O Allah, I ask You, at the coming of Your prayer, the voices of Your callers, the passing of Your night and the coming of Your day, to give Muhammad the Wasilah, the excellence and the lofty rank, and raise him to the praised station You promised him; You do not break Your promise.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid
items.note: At 'al-salatu khayrun min al-nawm' say: صدقت وبررت (you have spoken truly and well). At 'qad qamat al-salah' say: أقامها الله وأدامها.

items.ar: اللهم أنت السلام، ومنك السلام، وإليك يعود السلام، فحينا ربنا بالسلام، وأدخلنا الجنة دار السلام، تباركت يا ذا الجلال والإكرام
items.en: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace, and to You peace returns. Greet us, our Lord, with peace, and admit us to Paradise, the abode of peace. Blessed are You, Possessor of Majesty and Honour.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid
items.note: This is how al-Ghazali begins; he continues with tasbih and tahlil and then the comprehensive du'as.

items.ar: اللهم اجعل لي نورا في قلبي، ونورا في قبري، ونورا في سمعي، ونورا في بصري، ونورا في شعري، ونورا في بشري، ونورا في لحمي، ونورا في دمي، ونورا في عظامي، ونورا من بين يدي، ونورا من خلفي، ونورا عن يميني، ونورا عن شمالي، ونورا من فوقي، ونورا من تحتي، اللهم زدني نورا، وأعطني نورا أعظم نور، واجعل لي نورا برحمتك يا أرحم الراحمين
items.en: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my grave, light in my hearing, light in my sight, in my hair, my skin, my flesh, my blood and my bones; light before me and behind me, on my right and my left, above me and below me. O Allah, increase me in light, give me the greatest light, and make light for me, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of entering the masjid (said after the sunnah of Fajr)

items.ar: باسمك ربي وضعت جنبي وباسمك أرفعه، فاغفر لي ذنبي، اللهم قني عذابك يوم تبعث عبادك، اللهم باسمك أحيا وأموت، أعوذ بك اللهم من شر كل ذي شر، ومن شر كل دابة أنت آخذ بناصيتها، إن ربي على صراط مستقيم، اللهم أنت الأول فليس قبلك شيء، وأنت الآخر فليس بعدك شيء، وأنت الظاهر فليس فوقك شيء، وأنت الباطن فليس دونك شيء، اقض عني الدين، وأغنني من الفقر، اللهم أنت خلقت نفسي وأنت تتوفاها، لك مماتها ومحياها، إن أمتها فاغفر لها، وإن أحييتها فاحفظها بما تحفظ به عبادك الصالحين، اللهم إني أسألك العفو والعافية في الدين والدنيا والآخرة، اللهم أيقظني في أحب الساعات إليك، واستعملني بأحب الأعمال إليك، لتقربني إليك زلفى، وتبعدني عن سخطك بعدا، أسألك فتعطيني، وأستغفرك فتغفر لي، وأدعوك فتستجيب لي
items.en: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side and in Your name I raise it, so forgive me my sin. O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise Your servants. O Allah, in Your name I live and die. I seek refuge in You, O Allah, from the evil of every evil thing and every creature whose forelock You hold; my Lord is on a straight path. O Allah, You are the First, nothing is before You; the Last, nothing is after You; the Manifest, nothing is above You; the Hidden, nothing is beneath You. Settle my debt and free me from poverty. O Allah, You created my soul and You take it; its death and its life are Yours. If You take it, forgive it; if You let it live, protect it as You protect Your righteous servants. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my world and the Hereafter. O Allah, wake me at the hour most beloved to You and use me in the deeds most beloved to You, to bring me near to You and far from Your displeasure. I ask and You give me; I seek forgiveness and You forgive me; I call on You and You answer me.
items.src: Imam al-Ghazali, Bidayat al-Hidayah, the manners of sleep
items.note: Then recite Ayat al-Kursi, the end of al-Baqarah, al-Ikhlas, the two Mu'awwidhatayn and Tabarak (al-Mulk), and sleep in wudu, on your right side, facing the qiblah.
